prose: Tencent's chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu, a former OpenAI researcher, said AI models will soon be powerful enough to master biology, with benefits such as faster drug discovery and risks including bioweapons and a new pandemic, per SCMP. Speaking at a Hong Kong science symposium on Saturday, he said cyber abilities and soon bio abilities of models will reach a threshold where it is possible to do harm. Only the opening of the article was readable, so his proposed responses are not covered.
highlights: Yao: models will soon master biology.
Upside: faster drug discovery. Downside: bioweapons and pandemic risk.
Cyber and bio abilities near a harm threshold, in his words.
Remarks at a Hong Kong science symposium.
